prompt: Create ONE production 2D game sprite sheet with transparent background. REFERENCE image defines the EXACT same cute black-and-white doodle soldier identity: small rounded white helmet with brim, simple circular face, solid black outline, tiny black eyes, white body uniform with black harness straps, simple backpack and boots. Draw NEW complete anatomical poses, not cut-and-pasted parts. Keep every head identical size and line weight. Use a simple compact assault rifle MATCHING the reference, thick readable black silhouette, never a rocket tube, never photorealistic detailed gun. Each pose MUST have the complete connected head, torso, both arms, hands correctly gripping the stock and foregrip, legs and whole rifle. No holes, missing elbows or detached guns. White areas remain opaque; surrounding background alpha transparent. Smooth black ink cartoon, minimal shading, no colors, no paper/no gray background/no shadows/no text/no labels/no grid. Exactly 12 distinct sprites arranged in a strict 4-column by 3-row uniform grid, equally spaced generous transparent gutters, all facing right. Same scale throughout, each within its cell with wide margin around the entire barrel and feet. Row1: cell1 horizontal rifle aiming RIGHT while jumping with knees tucked; cell2 horizontal rifle aiming RIGHT in another airborne kick pose; cell3 horizontal rifle aiming RIGHT while descending with legs slightly extended; cell4 horizontal rifle aiming RIGHT in another descending pose. Row2: cell1 standing steady rifle aimed VERTICALLY UP, hands raise it in front of the head; cell2 crouching rifle aimed VERTICALLY UP; cell3 jumping legs tucked rifle aimed VERTICALLY UP; cell4 falling legs extended rifle aimed VERTICALLY UP. Row3: cell1 standing or running rifle aimed exactly 45 DEGREES UP-RIGHT; cell2 crouching rifle aimed exactly 45 DEGREES UP-RIGHT; cell3 jumping rifle aimed exactly 45 DEGREES UP-RIGHT; cell4 descending rifle aimed exactly 45 DEGREES UP-RIGHT. The rifle bore must actually point at the stated angle, hands/arms naturally follow. Body stays upright even when gun aims up; don't rotate the entire standing soldier. No muzzle flashes, bullets, motion trails or detached effects. Preserve the reference soldier's playful simple silhouette, same proportions and clean outlines at game sprite scale. This is one cohesive sprite asset sheet, not a poster.
